g.text: Active Recall
What conditions make a penetration test a properly authorized
white-hat activity?
References: EC-Q001、EC-Q054、P3-Q124、EC-Q166、EC-Q189、EC-Q331、
EC-Q476
Reference answer
Obtain valid authorization from someone with the authority to grant
it. Agree on targets, testing times, method restrictions and
notifications, then work within the scope and ROE.
Identify and validate vulnerabilities to help reduce risk, provide a
report and remediation recommendations, and retest as agreed. For an
out-of-scope target, stop active testing of that target and request
expanded authorization.
Which CIA objective is affected by exposed records, an
altered blood type and an unavailable registration system?
References: P1-Q003
Reference answer
Unauthorized viewing of records affects confidentiality. Changing
blood type A to B without authorization affects integrity. A
registration system disabled by denial of service affects
availability.
Non-repudiation concerns evidence of actions and accountability; it
is not the direct objective affected by unauthorized viewing.
Why are guards and door access controls still needed when
firewalls and encryption are in place?
References: P3-Q113
Reference answer
Guards and door access controls protect physical spaces and equipment
and are physical controls. Firewalls and encryption are technical
controls. Policies, authorization procedures and training are
administrative controls.
Defense in depth combines protections for facilities, people, systems
, data and incident response. No single control guarantees that every
attack is prevented.
Answer in your mind before revealing the answer. Viewing or revealing
a card supports review; it does not establish understanding or exam
readiness.
